instructions: weave maps a repo: UI pages -> HTTP endpoints -> modules -> database tables, plus tests. When a task describes a screen, a URL or a behaviour rather than a file, call search("plain words") first: it finds routes grep cannot, because their URL is joined from pieces. context(files) says what a file is in the app (page, endpoints, tables, owning change, tests and the command to run them); skip it for an edit inside one file you already found. Before renaming or removing a route or procedure, call impact(files) for every caller instead of grepping for each. Grep is still the right tool for a symbol whose exact name you already know. changed() tells you what the graph gained or lost since a branch point. Before saying a task is done, call verify(): it runs the gate on the diff, names the closest route for any broken call, and returns the commands that prove it. No tool returns whole files; text search returns matching lines only, and every output is capped. This server serves several projects: pass `project` (a name from `weave projects`) to pick one; omit it for this repo.
